content: Unlocked by CL-26. The C function (7 lines for the wrapper, ~50 lines for bcf_get_info_int32 etc.) calls bcf_hdr_id2int then scans d.info for the matching key, copies data into a caller-provided buffer. With our HeaderView cache this becomes a dict_lookup + info array scan + typed copy. The buffer is already managed by the Rust Buffer struct.
